profile.headline: Sr Embedded Software Developer
profile.summary: Applying the knowledge from different points of view, gained throw several situations on the field, design, validation and testing not forgetting to develop new expertices as needed for the project

positions.title: Sr Embedded Software Developer
positions.description:
Breaking Division:
Support Integration to SW Core development
Direct support at Low Level Drivers on core features from Infineon (TC2x & TC3x)
Include actuators support and safety validation to ZF brochure

positions.title: Embedded Software Developer
positions.description:
Breaking Division:
Direct support on safety features as SafeTlib from Infineon (TC2x)
Direct support on MBIST, LBIST and safety features from Infineon (TC3x)
Development for platform core focused on multiclient support.

positions.title: Embedded Software Developer
positions.description:
Breaking Division:
Embedded software development at Detroit area
Migration/Maintenance/development of complex drivers (Low Level Drivers - MCAL, ECAL) - Infineon (TC26x & TC36x)
Use of AUTOSAR and ISO26262 standards.

positions.title: Embedded Software Developer
positions.description:
Automotive Telematics:
Developing and maintenance on Low Level Driver prototyping and hot start up used for Software development and testing

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
GUI Maintenance and development for customized testing briefcase SW & HW
- SW Development support (EOL SW validation support)
Documentation and training support with remote debugging test equipment

positions.title: Embedded Software  Developer Jr.
positions.description:
Automotive Telematics:
Develop and maintenance on Factory_Test_DV embedded software used for testing every module at the factory, involving NAND programming, RAM test, NAD interface, Packet data connection among others.

Prototype builds with Continental multimedia products.
Development and support SW for: Program and validate units On the Go with Continental custom interfaces.
Onsite Support: Detroit - Michigan, Alabama, Saltillo - Mexico, Nogales - Mexico.
Team collaboration: Deer Park - Illinois, Wetzlar - Germany, Nogales - Mexico, Guadalajara - Mexico.

positions.title: Embedded and Support Engineer on 8/16 bits
positions.description:
Hildebrando Contractor:
Develop SW with SDA on a 8 Bit MCU from low drivers throw application procedures.
Sensors area collaborating with; embedded code, GUI and a test bench  for a new product making it compliant with the MISRA automotive standard.
Zigbee area collaborating with; embedded code and GUI modification for project compatibility between 8 bit MCU’s families.
Web Marketing area with Web launch activity. Acquiring an overall Knowledge of Freescale MSG portfolio (8, 16, 32-bit).
Supporting special projects; HEBE accelerometer from automotive application division and Zigbee modular code.

positions.title: MDS Technician
positions.description:
Detect and validate errors in PCB’s
Testing Activities: Failure detection, basic functional standards assurance.
Prototypes production: Giving direct support to the client and new board.
